title: Nexus OrchestrationPresetsApi
description: Canonical wire DTOs for the `/v1/daemon/orchestration/presets*` read surface (`orchestration-presets-api` destination). Migrated verbatim from the retired handwritten `nexus-contracts::local::orchestration::http` preset definitions: wire casing stays camelCase, optional manifest fields stay absent-when-not-carried (AR-21), and the trigger-lane booleans stay the flat PL-3 vocabulary the CLI `preset show --json` output matches verbatim (AR-25). Deliberately NOT part of this contract: an update-request `expected_source_hash` — the existing `UpdatePresetRequest` stays YAML-only and the strategy revision CAS remains the accepted write guard (P3-T4 request declined without evidence of an existing versioned update contract).

OrchestrationPresetListResponse.title: OrchestrationPresetListResponse
OrchestrationPresetListResponse.description: Response body for `GET /v1/daemon/orchestration/presets` (loadable preset ids). Named `OrchestrationPresetListResponse` because `preset-management` already owns the canonical `ListPresetsResponse` wire shape (`embedded`/`system`/`user`), and the two shapes are not interchangeable.

PresetProfileResponse.title: PresetProfileResponse
PresetProfileResponse.description: Response body for `GET /v1/daemon/orchestration/presets/{id}/profile` (AR-20..23): a manifest-derived profile for any resolvable preset. Pure read of the already-loaded preset; manifest fields the preset does not carry serialize absent.

id.description: Preset identifier from the loaded manifest (`LoadedPreset.id`).

sourceHash.description: blake3 hex hash of the source YAML (identity across restarts).

roles.description: Role definitions; absent when empty (single-agent mode).

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities this preset requires; absent when empty.

signals.description: Declared signal bindings (declared, not delivered); absent when empty.

PresetProfileLanes.title: PresetProfileLanes
PresetProfileLanes.description: Trigger-lane classification: the four locked PL-3 lanes (cron / wall-clock / session / direct) as a flat wire mirror, not a state machine.

cron.description: This preset id is one of the works-cron role presets (brainstorm / write / review per `RolesSchedule`).

wallClock.description: Daemon schedule admission on a wall-clock tick.

session.description: Session start can load it (embedded and system presets only; user presets report false, W-003/F-002).

direct.description: Schedule start with an explicit run payload.

PresetProfileState.title: PresetProfileState
PresetProfileState.description: One state of the outer state machine.

enter.description: Enter action kinds (`capability` / `inner_graph` / `host_tool`); absent when empty.

name.description: Capability name, inner graph name, or tool name.

PresetProfileExitWhen.title: PresetProfileExitWhen
PresetProfileExitWhen.description: Exit condition (`llm_judge` / `rule` / `graph_complete` / `manual` / `timer`); absent for terminal states.

PresetProfileNext.title: PresetProfileNext
PresetProfileNext.description: Next transition form (`linear` / `goNogo` / `labeled` / `conditional` / `branches`); absent for terminal states.

rules.description: Conditional rules (`conditional` legacy form); absent when empty.

branches.description: Expression branches (`branches` form); absent when empty.

label.description: Label the judge returns to select this edge.

target.description: Target state id when the expression evaluates true.

systemPromptFile.description: System prompt template path relative to the bundle root.

recommendedSkills.description: Recommended skill slugs, ordered (first = primary); absent when empty.
